answer: Each epoch the registry builds a payout graph and runs Louvain clustering, freezing any cluster whose external inflow share drops below 4% of its total payouts. Surviving identities collect rewards through a 14-day escrow and need receipts from 5 distinct clients with $25 of settled history. A 10,000 clone swarm then needs 50,000 client receipts, about $1.25M of staged volume, and 336 hours before first payout. Closed sybil rings grip each other like vine on smooth marble, while honest agents have ragged edges where outside clients land like sparrows on a ledge.
